name: Silicon Box advanced packaging factory, Tampines, Singapore

process_nodes.label: Panel-level packaging

process_nodes.label: SiPlet
process_nodes.note: Silicon Box's own name for its production line technology.

summary: Silicon Box's first factory, an SGD 2 billion panel-level advanced packaging plant for chiplet-based devices in the Tampines Wafer Fab Park in eastern Singapore. The 73,000 square metre building opened in July 2023 after about 11 months of construction, and mass production for early customers began in October 2023. Shipments passed 1 billion units by October 2026, and a USD 300 million capacity expansion inside the site began in May 2026, with full installation expected by 2028.

metrics.note: Expansion of production capacity at the existing site, begun in May 2026.

milestones.note: The company says the building was completed in about 11 months; grand opening held in July 2023.
Full installation of the expanded capacity is expected by 2028.

notes: The status is operating because the 2026 expansion adds capacity inside the existing factory rather than a new building. Cumulative shipments reported by the company: 100 million units by October 2025, 500 million by August 2026 and more than 1 billion by October 2026.
